{{Quote|I always used to think of myself as a good person. I was proud of it. But now, looking back, I was just ''pretending'' to be good. You know? Acting. It wasn't real at all. I was just&hellip;pretending to be a Jedi.''"<br />"''Whie, listen to me. Sometimes pretending is all there is.|Whie Malreaux and Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
'''Whie Malreaux''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Born on Vjun was he. Insane, the father went. And his mother...very strong she was. Very strong.|Yoda about Whie Malreaux|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
[[File:WhieMalreauxLightsaber-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|Whie Malreaux wielded his green-bladed lightsaber.]]
From a very young age, it was clear that the graceful, controlled Whie was strong with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Maks Leem]] took him on as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner. One of Whie's gifts was the ability to see the future in his dreams and meditations; premonitions, or true dreams. At first, this frightened him, but he learned to live with it by taking to heart that the future was always in motion; nothing was set.<ref name="Y:DR" />

His homeworld, [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], was a barren world where poison rain fell from the sky. Whie's family was one of the wealthiest on the planet, and lived in a castle: the [[Château Malreaux]]. The better families on Vjun traditionally had very high [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] counts, which was a mark of status among them. After a trade route was set up with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] became involved, wanting to take away the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] babies for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]].<ref name="Y:DR" />

Whie's father, the [[Malreaux|Viscount]], was extremely interested in the midi-chlorian phenomenon, and tried to genetically enhance natural midi-chlorians in Vjun's population. The experiment was only a partial success; the people went mad and started killing each other. Whie's mother [[Whirry Malreaux|Whirry]], half drunk and crazy, gave him away to a passing Jedi.<ref name="Y:DR" />

===Mission to Vjun===
====Darkest dreams====
{{Quote|Kiss her. Kiss her, Whie. Welcome home.|Asajj Ventress, in a vision to Whie Malreaux|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
[[File:Tallisibeth_Enwandung-Esterhazy.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tallisibeth "Scout" Enwandung-Esterhazy, the girl of Malreaux's true dream]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Malreaux was confronted by a furious Troxan diplomat at the entrance to the Jedi Temple. He summoned Master Leem, who used the Force to calm the Troxan, promising to deliver the Troxan's package to Master Yoda herself. As the delivery was inside an [[incendiary packet]], Malreaux wryly suggested that Leem not drop it, evoking a triple-eye roll. After receiving the packet, Yoda asked if Leem had a Padawan, going on to inquire if Malreaux filled the void left by her two previous Padawan learners. Yoda then questioned if Malreaux was ready for the larger galaxy. Leem, answering both no and yes, cited Malreaux's youth but also how he carried himself, praising his serenity and poise. Yoda agreed, but Leem detected hesitation in his voice. Elaborating, Yoda stated that Malreaux strongly wished to please Leem.<ref name="Y:DR" />

That night, Malreaux had a true dream. He found himself in a richly-furnished room, flanked by two figures. The first figure Malreaux recognized; [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]], or Scout, a Jedi apprentice a year older than him, was injured and bleeding. The other figure, an unknown [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|bald woman]], whispered to kiss Enwandung-Esterhazy. Dreaming Malreaux recoiled, but his waking self found the compulsion desirable, though angry, sick, and ashamed. The bald woman then welcomed him home. Awakening to find Leem and his dorm-mates beside him, Malreaux denied having had a true dream, reassuring his master. Malreaux, who had never dreamed of himself in a far older body, also speculated that his death would be coming soon.<ref name="Y:DR" />

====The tournament====
{{Quote|I guess that leaves you and me, sport.''"<br />"''You're still&mdash;I mean, I thought I was done.''"<br />"''Hey, we don't have to fight.''"<br />"''I would prefer that. It's just&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;You can always surrender.''"<br />"''<nowiki />''Me''? Surrender to ''you''? I don't think so.|Scout Enwandung-Esterhazy and Whie Malreaux|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
During the [[Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament]], Malreaux disarmed his first opponent and put the second in a wrist lock. Defeating them effortlessly, Malreaux moved on to be one of eight finalists in the tournament. Afterward, Leem sought to find Malreaux to offer him advice, really to calm her own nerves. Yoda, who had invited Leem to join him in the dining hall, praised Malreaux's performance, which Leem acknowledged, before asking her if Malreaux had had a nightmare. Leem explained that Malreaux denied it and that it was unlike him to lie, though both Jedi had detected the disturbance in the Force created by the dream. Malreaux, who sat three tables over, remained reserved from conversation with his peers. Malreaux turned and smiled at Leem, offering a respectful nod. Yoda then explained Malreaux's origins to Leem.<ref name="Y:DR" />

Jedi Master Jai Maruk joined the pair and indirectly confirmed that Leem's apprentice still remained in the tournament. Soon after, Master Xan made an announcement initiating an immediate free-for-all among the remaining Padawans.<ref name="Y:DR" />

Engaged against [[Hera Tuix]], Malreaux put her in a wrist lock, causing her to yield. Enwandung-Esterhazy and her friend [[Lena Missa]] rushed Malreaux while his back was turned, but he anticipated the attack, doing a backflip to land on a table behind him. Malreaux parried a blow to his legs only to recognize who he was facing, causing him to visibly recoil. Both girls attacked simultaneously, but Malreaux leapt forward above their heads, using the Force to shove Enwandung-Esterhazy into the table. Shortly thereafter, only Missa and Malreaux remained. In front of the kitchen doors, Malreaux fought Missa, weaving a cage of light around her. Missa thrusted; Malreaux sidestepped, clamping down on her sword hand and pivoting to put her in a thumb lock. Applying pressure, Malreaux forced Missa to drop her lightsaber and surrender. Smiling, Malreaux let Missa go and bowed. She curtsied in return, and the crowd applauded.<ref name="Y:DR" />

Twirling her lightsaber, Enwandung-Esterhazy declared herself and Malreaux the final competitors. When his face fell, Enwandung-Esterhazy suggested the two did not need to fight, relieving him; Enwandung-Esterhazy offered to accept his surrender. The young Jedi refused and, composing himself, drew his weapon. Parrying both Enwandung-Esterhazy's lunge and disengage, Malreaux grabbed her hand and, using the weapon as leverage, brought her into a thumb luck, the same technique he had used on Missa. Forcing Enwandung-Esterhazy to drop her lightsaber, Malreaux pleaded with her to end the bout, further twisting the girl's thumb to force her submission. As Enwandung-Esterhazy dropped down and back into Malreaux's hold, he let go as to not break his opponent's thumb. Advantaging his act of kindness, Enwandung-Esterhazy took hold of Malreaux's arm as he leapt away, executing a shoulder throw that brought him to the ground. Malreaux twitched, but Enwandung-Esterhazy already had a choke hold prepared, causing the boy to yield.<ref name="Y:DR" />

====Phindar and Vjun====
{{Quote|I have a peculiar talent. I dream the future. Last night, for instance, I dreamed my own death. And this wasn't it. Actually&mdash;and I think you'll find this amusing, I learned that I will die under a Jedi's hand. So I'm afraid you're out of luck. Doesn't mean I can't kill ''you''.''"<br />"''Do you want to?''"<br />"''You killed the person I loved best in the world. You stabbed her in the chest while she was helpless. I'd say my reasons are pretty good.|A hysterical Whie Malreaux, to Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
[[File:Dark_Rendezvous.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Malreaux watches as Ventress holds Scout in a Force grip.]]
Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had taken over Château Malreaux and made it into his hiding place, where he set up a trap for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order's]] most powerful Jedi Master, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The Jedi Master selected a small group of Jedi to come along with him to Vjun. Whie was among them, as was his Master Maks Leem, fellow Padawan Scout, and her Master [[Jai Maruk]]. During the mission, Whie dreamed his own death in a vision.<ref name="Y:DR" />

While Yoda confronted Count Dooku, Scout and Whie ran into [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Both Padawans were captured and Scout was held by a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-grip]]. Ventress, sensing Whie's feelings for Scout, tried to tempt Whie to the dark side by telling him to kiss Scout. Holding the life of Scout in her hand, she forced him to choose. Whie was in doubt, but Scout managed to say that he would make the right choice, upon which he did.<ref name="Y:DR" />

Yoda was able to escape from Dooku's trap, and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] came to the rescue. Ventress stole a shuttle and escaped. The Jedi returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] together, but Whie couldn't tell if he would ever feel at home again in the Jedi Temple. Yoda told him that he would always be home if he could feel the Force around him.<ref name="Y:DR" />

===Order 66===
{{Quote|The whole thing was confused. I'm not sure where I was, or what I was doing. I was in my own head; there was a lightsaber flashing. I tried to defend myself, but the other was too strong for me. Too fast. Then the light like a bar across my eyes. Like a sun. Then nothing.''"<br />"''Just because it was a lightsaber, that doesn't mean it was a Jedi.''"<br />"''Oh, but I knew. The dream was so short, I didn't even see who it was, but when I fell into the moment, I wasn't even frightened yet, I was just so ''surprised''. I was thinking, ''This is how I'm going to die?'' Isn't that weird. Even having had this dream, my death is still going to come as a surprise, when it happens. I guess it always does.|Whie Malreaux and Scout Enwandung-Esterhazy|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
[[File:Dralligbenewhie.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Whie was training with Master Cin Drallig and Bene when Order 66 was executed.]]
Whie was one of the Padawans in the Jedi Temple during the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. He was sparring with [[Bene/Legends|Bene]] when Darth Vader entered the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] in the Temple. Whie did not survive his encounter with the newly-named Sith Lord as he charged and was cut across the chest<ref name="Episode III" /> just as he had seen in one of his dreams.<ref name="Y:DR" /> [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] and Bene were soon to follow as victims of Vader.<ref name="Episode III" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] emerged, official records compiled by [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] stated that Whie was executed while in the act of mind-controlling the citizens of the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]].<ref name="O66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Jedi serenity is all very well, but in a thirteen-year-old boy it's sort of creepy.''"<br />"''What do you want from me?''"<br />"''Argue! Fight! Don't be this&hellip;this ''pretend Jedi''. Can't you just be human, for once?''"<br />"''No.|Scout Enwandung-Esterhazy and Whie Malreaux|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
As a Jedi, Malreaux was obedient and disciplined, through he came to doubt the sincerity of his principles.<ref name="Y:DR" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|The Force is strong in him. Not so strong as in young Skywalker, but in the next level down: and between you and me, he carries it better than Anakin ever has.|Maks Leem|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
Malreaux was strong in the Force. He sometimes experienced prophetic nightmares.<ref name="Y:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Though Whie's first appearance was in ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', he was originally created for ''Revenge of the Sith'' and used by author [[Sean Stewart]] when [[LucasBooks]] suggested he use a movie character in that role.<ref name="SWArchive-Rendezvous with Yoda: Six Questions for Sean Stewart">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/f20041203/index.html|text=Rendezvous with Yoda: Six Questions for Sean Stewart}}</ref>
